title: psi or bar? Systems of Units Explained Simply | PUC Physics Class 11
description:
A recipe asks for 8 ounces of flour, a road sign says 60 miles, a cricket pitch is 22 yards. And Aarav's tyre says 40 psi while the pump gauge only shows bar. In this animated lesson for PUC and Class 11 Physics (NCERT Chapter 1, Units and Measurement) we learn what a system of units is and meet the CGS, FPS (British) and MKS systems that NCERT names, and SI, which grew out of MKS.

A live simulation pushes one 2 kg trolley with a steady 4 N force while a dial switches between MKS, CGS and FPS: the trolley never changes, only the numbers and units do. We find the size of the dyne step by step (1 N = 10^5 dyn), compare a newton and a dyne side by side, convert 1 joule into 10^7 erg, and finally read Aarav's tyre: 40 psi is about 2.76 bar, and the SI unit of pressure is the pascal. Two pause-and-think questions, the exam trap about dynes, an original JEE Main pattern question with a full solution, a recap card and three questions to check yourself.

Made for PUC (Karnataka), CBSE Class 11, JEE Main and NEET students.
